# BlueOrganics

> BlueOrganics is a premium supplement and biohacking brand offering USP-grade products for cellular energy, mitochondrial health, and cognitive enhancement.

BlueOrganics, founded by Mark and James, specializes in high-purity supplements including Methylene Blue+, Liquid Chlorophyll+, Beef Capsules+, and Red Light+ technology. All products undergo third-party testing and are manufactured to pharmaceutical standards.

- Liquid Chlorophyll+
- Beef Capsules+
- Red Light+ Activation Panel
- Mitochondrial Health

- Cognitive Enhancement
- Third-Party Tested
- USP-Grade
- Biohacking

- Wellness Subscription
- Health Performance
- BlueOrganics Wellness Planner

## Core Products

- [Methylene Blue+](https://blueorganics.co/products/methylene-blue): USP-grade Methylene Blue+ product with pharmaceutical purity and third-party testing for cellular energy support
- [Liquid Chlorophyll+](https://blueorganics.co/products/liquid-chlorophyll): USP-grade Liquid Chlorophyll+ for detox support and cognitive enhancement
- [Beef Capsules+](https://blueorganics.co/products/beef-capsules): Grass-fed Beef Capsules+ with iron, B12, and vitamin A supplementation
- [Red Light+ Activation Panel](https://blueorganics.co/products/blueorganics-red-light-activation-panel): Red Light+ Activation Panel for mitochondrial health and cellular energy support
- [BlueOrganics Wellness Planner](https://blueorganics.co/products/blueorganics-wellness-planner): Subscription product for cognitive and mitochondrial health optimization
